                                      rate,

                                      effectiveperiod,
                                      ann_date_board,
                                      ann_date_shareholder,
                                      ann_date_ndrc,
                                      ann_date_csiec,
                                      ann_date_sfc,
                                      ann_date_implement,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
